limitations: All 108 titles have a partial principal/featured-character pass; this is not an exhaustive extraction of every credited, minor, or episodic anthology character.
Biographies are concise. Personality and relationship fields are usually empty because the available references did not support detailed claims consistently.
All character image fields are empty; no image URLs were added because stable, title-continuity-specific image sources were not confirmed for these profiles.

Age, height, birthday, first appearance, character development, ability IDs, power IDs, weapon IDs, fighting style, weaknesses, achievements and notable battles remain empty unless supported by the reviewed references.
Every title remains marked partial and needs additional character-by-character research. A populated character list is not a claim of completeness.
Roles are normalized to Main, Supporting or Antagonist and are editorial judgments based on narrative function, not official production labels.
